title: Bouncier Slime
description: Makes projectiles bounce on slime blocks instead of just landing
body: # Description Makes projectiles (except fireworks) bounce on slime blocks, inverting their vertical motion when they are close to landing on the top. High-speed projectiles will bounce high, while some will some will seem to hover over the slime blocks. Some examples of things you can do: - Build a roof of slime to redirect mob projectiles - Increase the range of potions and arrows - Make a mini-game where you have to launch a wind charge into a goal to hit a button # Versions Supports Java Edition 1.21.5 - 26.2 # Compatibility Incompatible with anything with the same filenames. Doesn't work on modded projectiles. May cause some lag due to somewhat unoptimized commands, but I havent tested if the lag is meaningful.
